sections.heading: 2. Scope and Acceptance
sections.content: These Terms & Conditions govern access to and use of hagroup.lv and its content and forms. By using the website, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please stop using the website.

sections.heading: 3. Informational Website — No Online Contract
sections.content: The website provides general information about our IT, cloud, DevOps, consulting, and software engineering services. It is not an online shop or a binding offer. Submitting a form, selecting a budget range, or receiving an acknowledgement does not place an order, create a service contract, guarantee a response, or oblige either party to proceed. Any project is subject to a separate written proposal or agreement covering scope, price, timing, responsibilities, and other applicable terms.

sections.heading: 4. Acceptable Use
sections.content: You may use the website only lawfully. You must not interfere with its security or operation, introduce malicious code, attempt unauthorized access, submit unlawful or misleading content, impersonate another person, or use automated tools to extract data in a way that disrupts the website or infringes rights.

sections.heading: 5. Forms and Communications
sections.content: You are responsible for ensuring that information submitted through contact or career forms is accurate and that you are entitled to provide it. We process form data as described in our Privacy Policy. The privacy checkbox confirms that you have read that policy; it is not blanket consent to every type of processing. Please do not include confidential, special-category, or unnecessary personal data in free-text fields.

sections.heading: 6. Intellectual Property
sections.content: Unless stated otherwise, the website design, original text, graphics, code, and HA Group branding are owned by or licensed to HA Group and are protected by applicable intellectual property laws. You may view and make a reasonable personal or internal-business copy for evaluating our services, but may not reproduce, modify, distribute, sell, or commercially exploit the content without prior written permission. Third-party names, trademarks, and materials remain the property of their respective owners.

sections.heading: 7. External Links
sections.content: The website may link to third-party websites or services. Links are provided for convenience and do not imply endorsement. We do not control third-party content, availability, security, or privacy practices; your use of those services is governed by their own terms and policies.

sections.heading: 8. Accuracy and Availability
sections.content: We take reasonable care to keep website information useful and current, but general service descriptions, case studies, timelines, budget ranges, and results are illustrative and are not warranties or promises of identical outcomes. The website may occasionally be unavailable, contain errors, or be changed, suspended, or discontinued.

sections.heading: 9. Liability for Website Use
sections.content: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, HA Group is not liable for indirect or consequential loss arising solely from use of, inability to use, or reliance on this informational website. Nothing in these terms excludes or limits liability that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited, including liability arising from fraud, wilful misconduct, or any mandatory consumer protection rule. Liability relating to paid services is governed by the applicable service agreement.

sections.heading: 10. Privacy and Browser Storage
sections.content: Our Privacy Policy explains how we process personal data, and our Cookie Policy explains the necessary browser storage used by this website. Those policies form part of the information governing your use of the website.

sections.heading: 11. Applicable Law and Disputes
sections.content: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Latvia. We encourage you to contact us first at info@hagroup.lv so that we can try to resolve any concern. Disputes are subject to the competent courts determined under applicable law. If you are a consumer in the European Economic Area, nothing in these terms deprives you of mandatory protections or jurisdiction rights available under the law of your country of residence.

sections.heading: 12. Changes to These Terms
sections.content: We may update these terms to reflect legal, technical, or business changes. The revised version applies from the date shown on this page and does not retroactively change an existing signed service agreement. Material changes will be communicated on the website where reasonably appropriate.

sections.heading: 13. Contact
sections.content: Questions about these Terms & Conditions may be sent to SIA HA Group at info@hagroup.lv.

SIA HA Group is the controller of personal data processed through this website.

sections.heading: 2. Scope and Sources
sections.content: This policy applies to personal data processed through hagroup.lv. We receive data directly from you when you submit a form or communicate with us, and limited technical data when your browser connects to and uses the website. If you provide another person's data, you must be entitled to do so and should make this policy available to that person.

sections.heading: 3. Data We Process
sections.content:
Project and contact inquiries: full name, company (optional), work email, selected project budget (optional), project details, privacy-policy acknowledgement, browser language, page URL, submission time, and form-mode indicators.

Career applications: full name, email, phone (optional), LinkedIn or portfolio URL (optional), position (optional), cover letter (optional), privacy-policy acknowledgement, browser language, page URL, and submission time.

Technical data: website hosting and security providers may process IP address, browser/device information, request time, requested page, and similar connection-log data. Your browser also stores the necessary preference and form-protection values listed in our Cookie Policy.

sections.heading: 4. Purposes and Legal Bases
sections.content:
We process data for the following purposes under Article 6 GDPR:

• To answer project inquiries, prepare proposals, and take steps requested before a possible contract — Article 6(1)(b), or our legitimate interest in managing business communications where that basis does not apply — Article 6(1)(f).
• To assess applications and manage recruitment — steps before a possible employment relationship under Article 6(1)(b) and our legitimate interest in selecting candidates and defending legal claims under Article 6(1)(f).
• To deliver and secure the website, prevent rapid repeat submissions, diagnose faults, and maintain service integrity — our legitimate interests under Article 6(1)(f).
• To keep records or disclose information where required by law — Article 6(1)(c), and to establish, exercise, or defend legal claims — Article 6(1)(f).

The privacy checkbox confirms that you have read this policy. We do not treat it as blanket consent. If we ask for consent for a separate optional purpose, Article 6(1)(a) applies and you may withdraw that consent at any time without affecting earlier lawful processing.

sections.heading: 5. Required and Optional Information
sections.content: Fields marked as required are needed to identify your request, reply to you, and understand the matter. If you do not provide them, we cannot process the form. Other fields are optional. Please do not submit special-category data (for example, health, biometric, political, religious, or trade-union information) or other information that is not necessary for your inquiry or application.

sections.heading: 6. Recipients and Service Providers
sections.content: Access is limited to authorized HA Group personnel who need the data for the relevant purpose. We use Google Firebase / Cloud Firestore to receive and store form submissions, and Amazon Web Services (including S3 and CloudFront) to host and deliver the website. These providers process data on our behalf under contractual and security obligations. Data may also be disclosed to professional advisers, courts, regulators, law-enforcement bodies, or other authorities where necessary and lawful. We do not sell personal data or share it with advertisers.

sections.heading: 7. International Transfers
sections.content: Some service providers may process data outside Latvia or the European Economic Area. Where personal data is transferred to a country without an applicable European Commission adequacy decision, we rely on safeguards permitted by Chapter V GDPR, such as the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses, together with supplementary measures where required. You may contact us for information about the relevant safeguards.

sections.heading: 8. Retention
sections.content:
We keep personal data only for as long as needed for the stated purpose:

• Project and contact inquiries: normally up to 24 months after the last substantive communication.
• Career applications: normally up to 12 months after submission. Longer talent-pool retention requires a separate legal basis, such as your specific consent.
• Hosting and security logs, if generated: for the period reasonably necessary for security, troubleshooting, and provider operations.
• Browser-stored values: for the periods described in our Cookie Policy.

Data may be kept longer where required by law or reasonably necessary to establish, exercise, or defend legal claims. It is then deleted or anonymized when the applicable period ends.

sections.heading: 9. Security
sections.content: We apply appropriate technical and organisational measures designed to protect personal data, including access controls, encrypted connections, service-provider security controls, and limiting access by purpose. No internet transmission or storage system can be guaranteed completely secure.

sections.heading: 10. Your GDPR Rights
sections.content: Subject to the conditions and exceptions in the GDPR, you may request access to and a copy of your data, correction, deletion, restriction of processing, and data portability. You may object to processing based on legitimate interests, including by explaining your particular situation. Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw it at any time without affecting processing carried out before withdrawal. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

sections.heading: 11. Exercising Rights and Complaints
sections.content:
Send requests to info@hagroup.lv. We may ask for information reasonably necessary to verify your identity. We will respond without undue delay and normally within one month; the GDPR permits an extension of up to two further months for complex or numerous requests, in which case we will inform you.

In Latvia, the supervisory authority is Datu valsts inspekcija, Elijas iela 17, Riga, LV-1050, Latvia; email pasts@dvi.gov.lv; website www.dvi.gov.lv. You may also complain to the supervisory authority in the EU/EEA country where you live, work, or believe an infringement occurred.

sections.heading: 12. Automated Decisions and Children
sections.content: We do not use website data for solely automated decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects, and we do not carry out advertising profiling. The website and its forms are intended for business contacts and job applicants, not for children.

sections.heading: 13. Policy Changes
sections.content: We may update this policy to reflect changes in our processing or legal obligations. The current version and its effective date will be published on this page. Where a change materially affects how we use existing data, we will provide additional notice or obtain consent if required by law.

This policy explains cookies and similar browser-storage technologies used on hagroup.lv. The current website uses first-party local storage rather than advertising or analytics cookies. Local storage keeps small values in your browser and, like cookies, can be removed through your browser settings.

sections.heading: 2. Storage We Use
sections.content:
The website currently stores only the following first-party values:

• cloudie-lang — remembers the language you select.
• cloudie-theme — remembers the light or dark color theme you select.
• cloudie-cookies — remembers that you acknowledged this storage notice so it is not shown on every visit.
• rate_limit_contact and rate_limit_career — store the time of a successful form submission to prevent rapid repeat submissions.

These values do not create a cross-site advertising profile and are not used to track you across other websites.

sections.heading: 3. Why Consent Is Not Requested
sections.content: The listed values are used to provide settings you explicitly request, remember this notice, or protect forms and website operation. Under Section 7¹(2) of Latvia's Information Society Services Law, storage that is necessary to provide a service requested by the user does not require consent, although clear information must still be provided. The notice therefore has an acknowledgement button rather than misleading accept/reject choices.

sections.heading: 4. No Analytics or Advertising Storage
sections.content: We currently do not use analytics, advertising, social-media, profiling, or other optional tracking cookies or browser storage. If that changes, we will update this policy and request your prior, freely given consent before any optional storage is placed or read. Refusing or later withdrawing such consent will be as easy as giving it and will not affect necessary website functions.

sections.heading: 5. Storage Periods
sections.content: cloudie-lang, cloudie-theme, and cloudie-cookies remain until you change the relevant setting or clear the website's stored data in your browser. The form-protection timestamps may remain in local storage until cleared, but the website stops using each timestamp to block another submission after 60 seconds.

sections.heading: 6. Managing Browser Storage
sections.content: You can inspect or delete the website's cookies and local storage through your browser's privacy or site-data settings. Deleting cloudie-lang or cloudie-theme resets the related preference; deleting cloudie-cookies makes the storage notice appear again. Blocking all local storage may prevent preferences and form protection from working as intended. The button below reopens the notice but does not itself delete other stored values.

sections.heading: 7. Service Providers and Other Data
sections.content: The site does not intentionally place third-party cookies. When you load pages or submit a form, our hosting and form service providers may process connection or form data as described in the Privacy Policy; that server-side processing is separate from the browser-storage values listed above. Links to external websites are governed by those websites' own cookie and privacy policies.

sections.heading: 8. Changes and Contact
sections.content: We may update this policy if our storage practices or legal obligations change. The latest version and date will be published here. Questions may be sent to SIA HA Group at info@hagroup.lv.
